subtitle: 5 questions in real TOEFL format. A new quiz on this week's words goes live every Sunday.
instructions: You have 35 seconds per question; the quiz moves on when time runs out.
Your score appears the moment you finish.

questions.prompt: In the paleontology passage, the author asserts that the existence of single-celled cyanobacteria was ________ in primordial oceans, appearing in rock strata dating back 3.5 billion years across all major continents.
questions.explanation: 'Ubiquitous' means present everywhere simultaneously. The author explains that cyanobacteria were found in rock strata across 'all major continents', confirming their widespread presence.

questions.prompt: The word 'ephemeral' in the biology passage refers to desert wildflowers that bloom exclusively after seasonal rains and wither within forty-eight hours. The word is closest in meaning to:
questions.explanation: 'Ephemeral' means lasting for a very short time; fleeting or transitory. Desert flowers withering within forty-eight hours are quintessential examples of short-lived phenomena.

questions.prompt: According to the geology text, the professor delivered a remarkably ________ exposition of plate tectonics, allowing exchange students with varied English proficiency to comprehend the subduction process without difficulty.
questions.explanation: 'Lucid' means clearly expressed, easy to understand, and completely transparent, which explains why international students grasped the concept without difficulty.

questions.prompt: Economic historians described the post-war agrarian reform as a ________ compromise, choosing policies that could be immediately implemented with existing farm equipment rather than waiting for industrialized tractors.
questions.explanation: 'Pragmatic' means practical and realistic, focused on immediate utility and tangible tools rather than abstract or perfectionist ideals.

questions.prompt: The anthropologist noted that ancient tribal rites once considered strictly ________ and shielded from outsiders have now been recorded and made available to global linguistics archives.
questions.explanation: 'Esoteric' refers to knowledge intended for or understood only by an enlightened inner circle of initiates, directly matching rituals previously shielded from outsiders.
